name: Sauron's Defenses
game_text:
To play, exert a <culture>Sauron</culture> Orc. Plays to your support area.
While there are 3 or more companions in the dead pile, the move limit for this turn is −1 (to a minimum of 1).
flavor_text: Sauron's minions are everywhere. Few roads escape the gaze of the Lidless Eye.
